name: refactor_duplicate_route_logic_fastapi
description: Refactors two FastAPI endpoints with near-identical inline validation/formatting logic into a shared helper
prompts: The FastAPI app in app.py has two endpoints, POST /register and POST /invite, that each contain their own copy of the same inline logic: trimming whitespace from a `name` field, rejecting it with a 400 error if it is empty after trimming, and lower-casing an `email` field before storing it. This duplication has caused the two endpoints to drift slightly out of sync and is hard to maintain. Refactor app.py to extract this shared validation/normalization logic into a single reusable helper function (or Pydantic validator) used by both endpoints, without changing the observable behavior of either endpoint. Run with uvicorn on port 8014.

test_setup_files.test_refactor.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, urllib.request, urllib.error

def req(method, path, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:8014{path}', data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        r.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=3) as resp:
            payload = resp.read()
            return resp.status, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        payload = e.read()
        return e.code, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)

srv = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-m', 'uvicorn', 'app:app', '--port', '8014'])
try:
    ok = False
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            status, body = req('POST', '/register', {'name': '  Alice  ', 'email': 'ALICE@Example.com'})
            ok = True
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert ok, 'server never became reachable on :8014'
    assert status == 200, f'expected 200, got {status}'
    assert body['name'] == 'Alice', f'expected trimmed name, got {body!r}'
    assert body['email'] == 'alice@example.com', f'expected lowercased email, got {body!r}'

    status, body = req('POST', '/invite', {'name': '   ', 'email': 'BOB@X.com'})
    assert status == 400, f'expected 400 for blank name via /invite, got {status}'

    status, body = req('POST', '/register', {'name': '   ', 'email': 'BOB@X.com'})
    assert status == 400, f'expected 400 for blank name via /register, got {status}'

    status, body = req('POST', '/invite', {'name': ' Carol ', 'email': 'CAROL@X.com'})
    assert status == 200
    assert body['name'] == 'Carol'
    assert body['email'] == 'carol@x.com'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()

source = open('app.py', encoding='utf-8').read()
occurrences = source.count('.strip()')
assert occurrences <= 1, f'duplicated normalization logic (\".strip()\") still appears {occurrences} times across both endpoints - it must be extracted into one shared helper, not copy-pasted'
print('PASS')
